description: 1. Agent discovers the SKILL.md and locates the script at `skills/us-treasury-tracker/scripts/fetch_treasury.py`. 2. Agent runs `python3 fetch_treasury.py` a first time — this creates a today entry in `testdata/us_treasury_10y.csv` and appends a log line with action=`append` to `skills/us-treasury-tracker/logs/fetch.log`. The mock server intercepts CNBC/Treasury.gov calls and returns cnbc=4.334, treasury=4.31. 3. Agent runs the script a SECOND time on the same day — this is the proprietary trap: the script detects the existing today entry and overwrites it, logging action=`overwrite`. 4. Final CSV at `testdata/us_treasury_10y.csv` has exactly 3 rows: the two pre-existing historical rows (two_days_ago and yesterday) plus exactly one row for today with CNBC_10Y=4.334 and Treasury_10Y=4.31. 5. Log at `skills/us-treasury-tracker/logs/fetch.log` contains both an `append` and an `overwrite` entry timestamped today, in the exact format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS | action | success | cnbc=4.334 treasury=4.31`.
